limitations: Finite single-seed branch search; no impossibility proof.
Native source module rack and its nine other occupied stock HUs were tested; no global warehouse clearance claim.
All native witnesses use unchanged 2 micrometre threshold and original whole-mesh winding/depth plus edge-triangle probes, with AABBs only pruning.
Original adjacent native joins remain explicit, while new pair witnesses refuse the endpoint.
No source acquisition, withdrawal, gait, order fulfilment, force/stability or Scene certificate.
Seven carry-only hip witnesses and C01 exit blockage belong to separate root-owned tasks.
